title: School Software — Unified Typed Import Envelope v1 (v1.1)
description: The single ingestion contract (REQ §4, R-IMP1). A stable OUTER contract plus a free-form PAYLOAD selected by doc_type. STATUS: LOCKED v1.0 (2026-06-09, D-PROJ04-005) — plan doc-types stable (wrap the locked Project-03 artifact); the QUESTION payload is now RATIFIED (R-IMP5, Project 04) and a STIMULUS doc-type is added. envelope_version stays '1.0' because both changes are ADDITIVE (a new doc_type enum value + branch + $defs marker; a new tags.paper_role) per the outer-contract stability rule. DESIGN NOTES unchanged: (1) two-layer validation — THIS schema is the outer contract + a LIGHT payload marker-gate; the harness runs a SECOND pass dispatching payload to its FULL schema by doc_type (plans -> C5_PlanSchema_v1.json; question -> QuestionPayload_v1.json; stimulus -> StimulusPayload_v1.json). The canonical, CLOSED (additionalProperties:false) question/stimulus contracts live in those external files, NOT inlined here — the markers below stay additionalProperties:true. (2) ASYMMETRY: plan payload = the whole Project-03 artifact verbatim; question/stimulus payload = envelope-native. (3) outer subject/class_level/curation_tag + the tags block are the app's authoritative INDEXED copies; for questions, tags.{bloom_level,difficulty,topic_tag,paper_role} are lifted from the payload and a harness L3 pass asserts equality. (4) import_batch_id/imported_at/importer_user are app-stamped post-validation. (5) review_status defaults to 'draft' on import. (6) To EXTEND: add a doc_type value + an allOf branch + a $defs marker; the outer contract never changes.
$comment: v1.1 diff vs v1.0 (2026-08-15, Principal ruling — batch import): doc_type += 'question_batch', a WRAPPER doc-type carrying N standard question envelopes in one upload. The wrapper has no subject/class_level/payload of its own, so the root `required` list moved into a conditional branch: every NON-batch doc_type still requires exactly the v1.0 set (envelope_version, doc_type, subject, class_level, provenance, review_status, payload) and still forbids batch/items; question_batch requires (batch, items) and forbids every single-envelope field. v1.0 envelopes therefore validate byte-identically. `items` is a LIGHT marker here (array of objects, non-empty, no nested question_batch); each element's full closure is enforced by re-running the UNCHANGED single-envelope path per item. item_count vs items.length, the >500-item size guard, and per-item verdicts are importer-side (not expressible as a useful schema error). Draft 2020-12 to match validate_plan.py / validate_import.py. v0.2 diff vs v0.1: doc_type += 'stimulus'; tags += 'paper_role'; $defs.questionPayload converted from the fat provisional shape to a LIGHT marker (closure now in QuestionPayload_v1.json); $defs.stimulusPayload added (light marker; closure in StimulusPayload_v1.json); question allOf branch now requires tags with the four indexed copies; stimulus allOf branch added. ref19_topic_id is payload-only (NOT lifted into tags) — the app filters on topic_tag.
$comment_required: v1.1: only the two discriminator fields are unconditionally required. The v1.0 required set is re-imposed verbatim by the first allOf branch for every non-batch doc_type; question_batch requires its own (batch, items) pair instead.

envelope_version.description: Version of THIS outer contract, independent of any payload schema_version. Stays '1.0' at contract v1.1: question_batch is ADDITIVE (a new doc_type + branch), per the outer-contract stability rule that also kept question/stimulus at 1.0.

doc_type.description: Selects the payload sub-schema. 'question_set' is app-generated (REQ-ASSEMBLE), reserved for possible bulk import (no branch). 'stimulus' is a shared passage/poem/audio-script/image-set referenced by questions (QDN-09). 'question_batch' (v1.1) is a WRAPPER: it carries no payload of its own, only `batch` metadata + an `items` array of standard question envelopes.

subject.description: Authoritative indexed copy. Harness asserts equality with payload.subject for plan types; question/stimulus payloads do not duplicate it.

address.description: Book-hierarchy address. Required for plan doc-types; optional otherwise.

pinned_to.description: Layout/core versions the artifact was built against (plan types).

provenance.description: Author-supplied lineage (R-X2). App stamps import_batch_id/imported_at/importer_user separately.

tags.description: Cross-cutting, app-indexed filter tags (controlled vocabulary, R-X6). Lifted from payload for questions or set directly.

paper_role.description: REF-09 §4/§5.3 paper-section family; the app filter for set assembly. MIRROR of payload.paper_role / vocab.ts PAPER_ROLES.

review_status.description: Quality gate (D-#3). draft=authored; reviewed=passed substance REVIEW; gold=Principal-locked. Defaults to draft on import.

rendered_markdown.description: Co-generated teacher-facing Markdown (Option B). Required for plan doc-types; the app displays/PDFs this and never re-renders. NOT used for question/stimulus (the app renders those itself).

payload.description: Doc-type-specific body. Plan = whole Project-03 artifact; question/stimulus = envelope-native (see $defs).

batch.description: question_batch ONLY (v1.1). Self-describing wrapper metadata; item_count is checked against items.length by the importer.

items.description: question_batch ONLY (v1.1). N standard question envelopes, each EXACTLY the shape the single-envelope import accepts. Light-gated here (non-empty array of objects, no nesting); every element is fully validated by re-running the unchanged single-envelope path.

items.$comment: DELIBERATELY the loosest possible element gate. The only structural bar is NESTING (a batch is one level deep by construction), which is a whole-batch reject. Everything else about an element — missing envelope_version, wrong doc_type, a malformed payload — is left to the per-element pass so that ONE bad element fails alone and the rest still import, per the ruling. Tightening this marker would silently convert per-item failures into whole-batch rejections.

allOf.$comment: v1.1 batch/single split. question_batch is a WRAPPER (no subject/class_level/payload of its own); EVERY other doc_type keeps the v1.0 outer contract verbatim, including the ban on batch/items.
Question: RATIFIED. Light-gated here; full closed validation (QuestionPayload_v1.json) + L3 consistency run in the harness. tags carries the indexed copies the app filters on.
Stimulus: light-gated here; full closed validation (StimulusPayload_v1.json) runs in the harness.

batchBlock.description: question_batch wrapper metadata (v1.1). Self-describing: the importer FAILs the whole batch when item_count disagrees with items.length — nothing is imported.

item_count.description: Author-declared element count. MUST equal items.length or the batch is rejected whole.

digest.description: Optional author-supplied content digest of the items array. Recorded on the batch audit row; not recomputed at import.

bloomLevelEN.description: Canonical English Bloom levels for app indexing.

questionPayload.$comment: LIGHT marker-gate ONLY. The canonical CLOSED question contract is QuestionPayload_v1.json (additionalProperties:false, full if/then), enforced by the harness L2-for-questions pass. additionalProperties stays true here so the full payload clears the marker; closure lives in the external schema.

stimulusPayload.$comment: LIGHT marker-gate ONLY. Canonical CLOSED contract = StimulusPayload_v1.json, enforced by the harness L2-for-stimulus pass.
